# Be On The Road

> > Travel blog featuring destination guides, cultural heritage sites, and travel tips across India, Middle East, Asia, and beyond.

Be On The Road is a comprehensive travel resource specializing in offbeat destinations, temple architecture, monsoon getaways, and budget travel advice. The site covers extensive India travel guides (Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, Rajasthan) alongside international destinations including UAE, Oman, Singapore, and the US Southwest.

## Key Topics

- India travel destinations
- Temple architecture and heritage sites
- Karnataka tourism
- Tamil Nadu cultural sites
- Rajasthan travel
- Middle East travel (UAE, Oman)
- Monsoon destinations
- Budget travel tips
- Family vacation planning
- Road trip guides
- Beach destinations
- Historical monuments
- Singapore tourism
- Travel photography
- Cultural heritage exploration

- [10 Mesmerizing Beaches of India](https://www.beontheroad.com/2019/05/10-mesmerizing-beaches-of-india.html): Top 10 Indian beach destinations for summer holiday planning
- [Unchalli Falls: Stunning Monsoon Holiday Destination of Karnataka](https://www.beontheroad.com/2020/10/unchalli-falls-top-monsoon-holiday-in-karnataka.html): Unchalli Falls monsoon destination guide in Karnataka's Western Ghats

## Temple Architecture & Heritage Sites

- [Udayagiri Caves: 5th Century Cultural Beauty of Madhya Pradesh](https://www.beontheroad.com/2020/12/udayagiri-caves-cultural-gem-madhya-pradesh.html): 5th century Udayagiri Caves in Madhya Pradesh with multi-religious iconography
- [Travel Photo: Decorated Pillars of Lepakshi Temple](https://www.beontheroad.com/2017/08/travel-photo-decorated-pillars-of-lepakshi-temple.html): Photo essay of Lepakshi's Veerbhadra Temple decorated pillars near Bangalore
- [Panchalingeswara Temple at Govindanahalli: Only Surviving Panchakuta temple from Hoysala era](https://www.beontheroad.com/2020/12/panchalingeshwara-panchakuta-hoysala-temple-.html): Rare Hoysala-era Panchakuta temple at Govindanahalli near Bangalore
- [10th Century Brahmadesam Kailasanathar Temple: Lesser Known Architectural Marvel of South India](https://www.beontheroad.com/2024/04/10th-century-kailasanathar-temple-brahmadesam-tirunelveli-tamil-nadu-india.html): 10th century Chola temple at Brahmadesam, Tirunelveli - architectural marvel
- [Athalanallur Gajendra Varadharaja Perumal Temple: The Location of Gajendra Moksham Legend](https://www.beontheroad.com/2026/01/athalanallur-gajendra-varadharaja-adhi-moolam-vishnu-temple.html): Athalanallur Vishnu temple in Tamil Nadu tied to Gajendra Moksham legend
- [Old Iron Bridge over the Thamirabharani River at Papanasam: A Rustic Gem with lots of Scenic Nature](https://www.beontheroad.com/2025/03/old-iron-bridge-over-thamirabharani-river-papanasam-tamil-nadu-rustic-gem.html): Historic iron bridge at Papanasam over Thamirabharani River in Tamil Nadu
